fields.name: timestamp
fields.justification: Provides one time field for correlation across all sources.

fields.name: hostname
fields.justification: Identifies which host produced or is associated with the event.

fields.name: source_type
fields.justification: Allows downstream analysis to distinguish Windows, Linux, and network events.

fields.name: event_category
fields.justification: Gives detection rules and analysts a consistent way to classify events.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Severity value when supplied or assigned by normalization.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to prioritize higher-risk events.

fields.name: user
fields.description: User account explicitly associated with the event.
fields.justification: Supports investigation of account activity without inventing a user when none is present.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Process name associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Supports process execution detection and investigation.

fields.name: process_id
fields.justification: Helps correlate activity from the same process.

fields.name: src_port
fields.justification: Supports network connection correlation and detection.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.justification: Supports investigation of outbound and lateral network connections.

fields.name: dst_port
fields.justification: Supports detection of connections to specific services.

fields.name: protocol
fields.justification: Supports protocol-based event classification and detection.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Original numeric event identifier when available.
fields.justification: Preserves source event identity for precise detection and investigation.

fields.name: provider
fields.justification: Preserves the component that generated the source event.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Original event message or record content.
fields.justification: Preserves source evidence for verification during investigation.

fields.name: event_data
fields.description: Additional structured source fields retained during normalization.
fields.justification: Keeps useful source-specific evidence that does not have a dedicated normalized field.

fields.name: source_origin
fields.description: Identifies the provenance of the event record.
fields.justification: Distinguishes evidence-pack data from student telemetry.
